subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should announce completion delivery use a trusted/reserved `announce:` run-id namespace and remain tool-free with killed reconciliation after interrupted delivery turns?
rationale: This changes both persisted session recovery semantics and the inter-session tool boundary, and the current prefix-only implementation has a public idempotency collision that maintainers should not accept silently.

options.title: Fix namespace then accept invariant
options.body: Require a backend-only/reserved announce namespace or provenance-bound marker first, then keep tool-free announce delivery and non-running reconciliation as the canonical fix.

options.title: Accept prefix collision risk
options.body: Merge the prefix-only implementation and accept that public `announce:*` idempotency keys can be treated as announce delivery runs during recovery.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a larger model for inter-session delivery, lock, and restart recovery before changing this lifecycle state.

recommendation.title: Fix namespace then accept invariant
recommendation.body: Require a backend-only/reserved announce namespace or provenance-bound marker first, then keep tool-free announce delivery and non-running reconciliation as the canonical fix.
